test_title: PYST 46: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following can be settled in a Lok Adalat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Compoundable offences**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Lok Adalat is an alternative dispute resolution mechanism established under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.
 
• Cases that can be settled in Lok Adalat include **compoundable offences, civil cases, and disputes related to bank recovery, matrimonial issues, and labor matters.**
 
• Compoundable offences refer to crimes where the complainant and accused can mutually agree to settle the matter outside court.
 
• The award passed by Lok Adalat is final and binding, and it holds the same status as a decree of a civil court.
 
• Lok Adalat provides a cost-effective and speedy resolution of disputes, avoiding lengthy litigation processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lok Adalat:**

 
 
• Also known as "People's Court," it is organized by the State/District Legal Services Authority, High Court, or Supreme Court committees.
 
• It promotes amicable settlement of disputes through conciliation and compromise.
 
• It does not involve court fees, and parties are free to directly interact with the presiding judge.
 
 
 
• **Compoundable Offences:**
 
 
• These are less severe crimes, such as theft, assault, or defamation, which can be settled with the victim's consent.
 
• The Indian Penal Code (IPC) specifies which offences are compoundable.
 
• Examples include Section 323 (voluntarily causing hurt) and Section 506 (criminal intimidation).
 
 
 
• **Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987:**
 
 
• It provides statutory backing for the establishment of Lok Adalat.
 
• The Act ensures free legal aid and promotes alternative dispute resolution mechanisms.
 
• Under the Act, Lok Adalat can resolve both pre-litigation and ongoing cases.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Lok Adalat:**
 
 
• Ensures faster resolution of cases compared to conventional courts.
 
• Reduces the workload of courts by addressing pending cases.
 
• Offers legal aid and settlement without imposing court fees.
